{ "subject": "Ask your questions, get inspired and give feedback", "body": { "contentType": "html", "content": "Welcome to the Ask Us Anything channel. In this channel you can:
  1. Ask all your questions whether they are technical or adoption related. Your Champions and Project Team will help answer any of your questions.
  2. Find information that will help you get the most from Microsoft 365 Copilot leveraging Copilot Lab.
  3. Stay on top of new features as they are being released through our roadmap

Most important is your feedback. Use the feedback button at the bottom right of your Copilot results and help us out by using the thumbs up/thumbs down buttons. Your feedback will be sent directly to our product engineering teams and help shape the future of Microsoft 365 Copilot.
